title: Where does your ₹20 go when you pay by UPI?
caption:
Where does your ₹20 actually go when you scan a UPI QR? 🤔

In about 2 seconds:
📱 Your UPI app sends the request to NPCI, the switch that connects every bank
🏦 Your bank checks your PIN and balance, and takes out ₹20
🏦 NPCI tells the chai wala's bank to add ₹20
🔊 His speaker says "₹20 received"

Your UPI PIN is encrypted on your phone, so even your app can't read it 🔒

India made 24.07 billion UPI payments in September 2026 (NPCI). That's over 9,000 every second 🤯

Save this for the next time someone asks how UPI works, and follow @maddieandchotu for one money question every day 💰
